'''Iotramine''' was a drug. It could be mixed with [[Clondex]] and administered to [[Pui-ui]] in order to treat enzyme eruptions in the [[Species/Legends|species]]' third [[Heart/Legends|heart]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
